new_findings.title: Watchdog bypasses retirement and does not implement total deadline
new_findings.smallest_closure: Use current validated authority, retire PID/group identities, own/reap watchdog sleeper, bound driver cancellation and final publication.

new_findings.title: K2 stale output predicate and predecessor receipt mismatch

new_findings.title: Receipt failure and final evidence work are not fully gated/bounded

new_findings.title: CLI hash refusal follows first CLI execution
new_findings.smallest_closure: Move client existence/hash verification before version invocation; keep CHECKPOINT_DISABLE export.
